name: Thurman's Sewing Kit
summary: At Larson Clothiers, Thurman's Sewing Kit is needed for the day's tailoring. Young apprentice Thurman Schneider left it at his family's home by the Canals, hoping to spend the day at leisure.

sections.title: A Reluctant Apprentice's Tools
sections.body: Thurman's Sewing Kit holds the needles, shears, and thread he needs for tailoring. Young Thurman studies at Larson Clothiers, deep in Stormwind's Mage Quarter near the Mage Tower. His mother, Rema Schneider, knows he cannot work without the kit. So she asks passersby along the Canals to carry it to the shop. When Thurman gets his tools, his reaction reveals he left them behind on purpose. He hoped to trade a day of stitching garments for leisure.

faq.q: What is inside Thurman's Sewing Kit?
faq.answer: The kit holds needles, shears, and thread for Thurman Schneider's tailoring work at Larson Clothiers.

faq.q: Who does this sewing kit belong to?
faq.answer: Thurman's Sewing Kit belongs to Thurman Schneider, a young apprentice working under the Larsons in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Why was the kit left behind at Thurman's home?
aliases: why did thurman forget his kit
faq.answer: Rema thought Thurman had rushed out and forgotten the kit. He left it behind on purpose, hoping to avoid a day of work at Larson Clothiers.

faq.q: Where does this kit need to be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the kit
faq.answer: Take the kit to Larson Clothiers in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter, near the Mage Tower.

angles.text: Every tailor knows the drudgery of early apprenticeship. Few go as far as young Thurman Schneider and leave their shears behind.
